sections.content:
When guiding someone or walking together in a city, directional postpositions are vital:
- *Gyere utánam!* (Follow me!)
- *Állj be mögém a sorba!* (Step behind me into the queue!)
- *Ülj le mellém a villamoson!* (Sit beside me on the tram!)
- *Ne menj el nélkülem!* (Don't leave without me!)

items.spanish: A villamosmegálló közvetlenül előttünk van a sarkon.
items.english: The tram stop is directly in front of us on the corner.

items.spanish: Kérlek, siess egy kicsit, ne maradj le mögöttem!
items.english: Please hurry a bit, don't fall behind me!

items.spanish: Minden rendben volt a séta alatt, köszönöm, hogy eljöttél velem.
items.english: Everything was great during the walk, thank you for coming with me.
